name: U.S. Bank Altitude® Reserve Visa Infinite® Card

welcome_offer.description: No welcome offer. Closed to new applications since November 11, 2024.

earning_rates.category: Prepaid hotels & car rentals booked in the U.S. Bank Travel Center
earning_rates.notes: 10x points when you use the card to book prepaid hotels and car rentals in the Travel Center (since Dec 15, 2025)

earning_rates.category: Prepaid flights booked in the U.S. Bank Travel Center
earning_rates.notes: 5x points when you use the card to book prepaid flights in the Travel Center (since Dec 15, 2025)

earning_rates.category: Travel (airlines, hotels, car rentals, taxis, limousines, passenger trains, cruise lines)
earning_rates.notes: 3x points on eligible travel purchases made directly with airlines, hotels, car rental companies, taxis, limousines, passenger trains and cruise line companies

earning_rates.category: Mobile Wallet (Apple Pay, Google Wallet, Samsung Pay)
earning_rates.notes: 3x points on mobile wallet spending on the first $5,000 each billing cycle, then 1x (cap added Dec 15, 2025)
1x point per $1 on all other eligible purchases

other_benefits.name: Points transfer
other_benefits.description: Transfer points to airline and hotel loyalty programs (added Dec 15, 2025)

other_benefits.name: Cell phone protection
other_benefits.description: Up to $600 coverage for stolen/damaged cell phones

sources.notes: Official U.S. Bank product page; as of 2026-10-02 it redirects to the general U.S. Bank credit card list (card no longer offered to new applicants)

Official U.S. Bank Altitude Reserve cardholder benefits page (usbank.com/AltitudeReserveBenefits), checked 2026-10-02: 10x/5x Travel Center, 3x travel, 3x mobile wallet on first $5,000 per billing cycle, $325 Travel Center credit, Priority Pass Select with 8 visits, $120 TSA PreCheck/Global Entry credit, points transfer, protections
Frequent Miler: Altitude Reserve no longer accepting new applications (closed 2024-11-11)
Upgraded Points: Altitude Reserve discontinued for new applicants
Upgraded Points: Dec 15, 2025 changes now live (1¢ travel redemptions, Travel Center-only $325 credit, $5,000 mobile wallet cap)
Doctor of Credit: Gogo inflight Wi-Fi passes discontinued April 1, 2022

discontinued_notes: Closed to new applications since November 11, 2024 (the official usbank.com product page now redirects to the U.S. Bank card list). Existing cardholders can keep using the card, and product changes may be possible. Sources: official usbank.com redirect, Frequent Miler, Upgraded Points.
notes: Closed to new applicants since Nov 11, 2024. Changes for existing cardholders effective Dec 15, 2025: points worth 1¢ each toward travel (was 1.5¢), the $325 credit only covers Travel Center bookings, 3x mobile wallet earning capped at $5,000 per billing cycle, 10x/5x on prepaid Travel Center hotels, car rentals and flights, and points can now be transferred to airline and hotel partners.

application_rules.notes: Closed to new applications since November 11, 2024. Existing cardholders can keep using the card; ask U.S. Bank about product change options.

recurring_credits.name: Travel Center credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $325 in automatic statement credits each year for travel booked through the U.S. Bank Travel Center with this card. Since Dec 15, 2025, dining and travel booked elsewhere no longer qualify.

recurring_credits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $120 statement credit for the Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee paid with the card, once every 4 years.
